Exhibition name: The McCartney Rose ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Alain Meilland (1940-....) (France, before 1988).
Introduced in France by Meilland et Cie in 1992 as 'The McCartney Rose'.
Introduced in United States by Conard-Pyle (Star Roses) in 1998 as 'The McCartney Rose'.
rows.Bloom: Pink, deep pink reverse. Strong fragrance. 20 to 40 petals. Average diameter 3.5". Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Semi-glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 31" to 6' (80 to 185cm). Width: 28" to 4'11" (70 to 150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to blackspot . Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
